hypotheses.party_welcome: The host explicitly welcomes parties, celebrations or events at this rental property.
hypotheses.social_amenities: The rental itself offers leisure or entertainment amenities for socializing, such as a hot tub, pool, games, bar, barbecue or outdoor gathering space.
hypotheses.party_restriction: The host prohibits parties, events, loud noise or disruptive gatherings at this property.
hypotheses.nearby_nightlife: The text describes bars, nightlife, entertainment venues or party activities nearby rather than at the rental itself.

notes: Call-blind zero-shot screening scores, not calibrated probabilities or confirmed behavior. Party signal additionally requires affirmative event-marketing language in one sentence; travel-group homonyms cannot supply the event. Review source excerpts.
